summary: Iteration 139 - targeted re-verification of the 4 GRN fixes from iteration_138 (no full re-test). ALL 4 FIXES VERIFIED PASS. (1) retry-movement / retry-goods-receipt now return 404 + clean JSON {'detail': 'No shipment found for this code'} for an unknown doc_code (was 500). (2) On a REAL end-to-end Approve of TESTG3 (fake PO 99999003, live SAP Playwright login, job took ~48s), data-testid='grn-job-progress' became visible IMMEDIATELY (~0s after clicking Approve) with text 'Posting to SAP...' and stayed visible for the whole in-flight window (screenshot captured). (3) The grn-sap-sync-status banner did NOT render at all while the job was in flight (no stale/premature 'SAP posting pending'), and after completion it correctly shows 'PO not found in SAP - check it's released (...)' - i.e. sap_sync_status='skipped', NOT 'posted'. (4) The Actual Qty column is still rendered post-approval: grn-actual-qty-value-99999003::10 = '100 EA' and ::20 = '50 EA'. The grn-retry-goods-receipt-button is visible and enabled. Movement banner correctly reads 'Warehouse movement skipped - Goods Receipt has not posted to SAP yet'. Backend regression suite (6 cases) added; 6/6 pass on a clean run. Only remaining finding is the previously-reported intermittent >60s stall of all /api/* requests correlated with the blocking sap_valuation_client background sync - reproduced again during this run and now confirmed from backend.err.log.

minor.issue: RECURRING (also reported in iteration_138): during a ~4 minute window the pytest run hit repeated ReadTimeout(60s) on /api/admin/grn/* endpoints that answer in 0.1s otherwise. /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log shows sap_valuation_client emitting dozens of blocking 'connect timeout=30' / 'read timeout=30' calls to my431827.businessbydesign.cloud.sap during exactly that window - the blocking sync work run via the default asyncio.to_thread executor saturates the thread pool and starves normal requests. Recommend a bounded/dedicated executor (or httpx async client) for the valuation sync, plus lower per-call timeouts.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A for the verified fixes (all resolved). For the remaining intermittent API stall: sap_valuation_client performs many synchronous `requests` calls with 30s connect/read timeouts against an unreachable SAP host; they are dispatched via asyncio.to_thread which uses the default ThreadPoolExecutor shared with every other blocking DB/SAP helper in the app, so during a sync round the executor queue is full and unrelated /api requests wait past the client's 60s timeout.
